asked.item: Why the "Invalid or expired token" error appeared
What to do after the code failed

verdict.reason: The help pages explain the \"Invalid or expired token\" error, the roughly 15-minute code expiry, and what to do when a code has expired.

steps.text: The "Invalid or expired token" error means the code was entered in the wrong session or after it expired.
If the code expired, request a fresh one at my.blotato.com/login and use it immediately.
Redo the transfer steps from your original browser.
